about: Cosmetics sold for gold, dropped by boxes or earned from collections. kind: theme, namePlate, backdrop, tradePlate, richListFlair or saveSlot. rarity: common, rare, epic, legendary. source: store (bought with gold), box (only from boxes), collection (reward for finishing a collection) or plan (given by a Ledger plan, never sold or dropped). theme: optional look theme id from Content/themes/item_themes.json (default classic); founderEdition: optional true; bound: optional true (not sellable). Store prices are in pricing/prices.json (by rarity, or by id for single items). colors: hex, tint first. Image: <kind>.<id>.png in App/Ledger/Resources/Content/art, with kind written theme, namePlate, backdrop, tradePlate or flair.
